issue_request: FHIR-18113 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 technical correction reporting that the StructureDefinition schematron for eld-13 was syntactically invalid because a closing ] was missing from the f:type preceding-sibling predicate.
initial_application: No commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-18113 was found. The defect appears to have been introduced by 292398314311cb4026b7620e7b6d7ce00a3c356a and corrected by 7bf7397f4a965784698e0d343f8a96789cdf4942, which changed source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml from the missing-bracket XPath to the corrected XPath.
additional_context: StructureDefinition is an active current resource in source/fhir.ini, and ElementDefinition spreadsheet source feeds the definitions and invariants used by StructureDefinition. Searches found no current source copy of the reported missing-bracket form and no Zulip or Confluence evidence that changes the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The no-change commit records that source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml line 4713 already has not(exists(for $type in f:type return $type/preceding-sibling::f:type[f:code/@value=$type/f:code/@value])) with the required closing predicate bracket.
